plaatsen.tekst: But by the grace of God I am what I am: and his grace which was bestowed upon me was not in vain; but I laboured more abundantly than they all: yet not I, but the grace of God which was with me.
Wherein God, willing more abundantly to shew unto the heirs of promise the immutability of his counsel, confirmed it by an oath:
And it is yet far more evident: for that after the similitude of Melchisedec there ariseth another priest,
And he charged them that they should tell no man: but the more he charged them, so much the more a great deal they published
